A change to **UserService** could affect **7 services** within four dependency hops.

| Service | Dependency path | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| ApiGateway | ApiGateway → UserService | Direct |
| AuditService | AuditService → UserService | Direct |
| OrderService | OrderService → UserService | Direct |
| BillingService | BillingService → OrderService → UserService | Indirect |
| ReportingService | ReportingService → OrderService → UserService | Indirect |
| SearchService | SearchService → OrderService → UserService | Indirect |
| RenewalsWorker | RenewalsWorker → BillingService → OrderService → UserService | Indirect |

Each arrow means “depends on.” Actual impact depends on what changes in UserService.
